author: Ryan Young
title: PGA Championship Final Round leaderboard, live updates: Scottie Scheffler regains control - Yahoo Sports
description: We're just 18 holes away from someone claiming the Wanamaker Trophy.
content_summary: Scottie Scheffler clinched a commanding victory at the 2025 PGA Championship held at Quail Hollow Club in North Carolina. Despite narrowly losing his five-shot lead due to three bogeys on the front nine, Scheffler rebounded with consecutive birdies on holes 14 and 15. He finished the tournament at 11-under par, securing his first ever PGA Championship title and third major overall. This win, which earned him the iconic Wanamaker Trophy, also marked his 15th career PGA Tour victory and reinforced his status as the world's top-ranked golfer. Scheffler took home a tournament record prize of $3.42 million from the $19 million purse. Runners-up Bryson DeChambeau, Harris English, and Davis Riley tied at 6-under par. Scheffler's ability to maintain composure under pressure showcased his elite skill and cements his growing legacy in golf.

author: Alex Harring
title: Stock futures slide after U.S. debt downgrade highlights deficit risk: Live updates - CNBC
description: The major indexes are coming off a winning week.
content_summary: Moodys downgraded the U.S. credit rating from Aaa to Aa1, signaling concerns about the growing federal budget deficit and the challenges of refinancing debt amid rising borrowing costs. This downgrade aligned Moodys with other rating agencies but sent Treasury yields sharply higher, with the 30-year bond yield surging past 5 percent. Despite these headwinds, equity markets showed resilience with the S and P 500 posting a marginal gain, extending its winning streak to six days. Investors remain cautiously optimistic, supported by strong corporate earnings driven partly by structural AI growth trends. Market attention is focused on tariff policies, trade negotiations particularly with China and the Federal Reserve's anticipated decisions regarding interest rate cuts. The downgrade's broader implications include increased borrowing costs for government and consumers, potentially impacting economic growth and mortgage rates.

author: Mostafa Salem, Ibrahim Dahman, Kara Fox, Dana Karni
title: Israel begins extensive Gaza ground operation after intense airstrikes kill more than 100 overnight - CNN
description: Israel launched an extensive ground operation in Gaza Sunday in addition to an intense air campaign that health officials in the territory say killed over 100 people overnight and shuttered the last functioning hospital in the enclave's north.
content_summary: Israel commenced an extensive ground operation in Gaza, supplementing ongoing intense airstrikes that reportedly killed over 100 individuals overnight and forced closure of the last functioning hospital in northern Gaza. The military campaign, code-named 'Gideon's Chariots,' aims to defeat Hamas and achieve the release of hostages amid indirect peace talks mediated by Qatar. While Israel is permitting limited food aid into Gaza to prevent famine, humanitarian organizations warn of a worsening crisis due to blockades and the destruction of medical infrastructure. Hamas has provided mixed signals regarding hostage release arrangements tied to ceasefire terms. The conflict's toll continues to mount, with thousands of casualties, predominantly civilians, and displaced populations. International mediators and the UN are pushing for de-escalation but the situation remains volatile, with diplomatic progress uncertain and grave humanitarian needs escalating.

author: Mark Gurman, Drake Bennett
title: Why Apple Still Hasn't Cracked AI - Bloomberg.com
description: Insiders say continued failure to get artificial intelligence right threatens everything from the iPhone's dominance to plans for robots and other futuristic products.
content_summary: Despite initial optimism sparked by the hiring of AI expert John Giannandrea in 2018, Apple has struggled to make significant advances in artificial intelligence, impacting its competitiveness in voice assistants, smartphone dominance, and future technology endeavors including robotics. Competing companies like Google and Amazon have surpassed Apple in developing more sophisticated AI-enabled products, exposing Apple's challenges in adapting to the rapidly evolving AI landscape. This shortfall raises concerns regarding Apple's future innovation trajectory and market leadership. Insider analysis attributes difficulties to cultural and technical hurdles within Apple's AI division, compounded by high consumer expectations for breakthroughs in AI functionality and integration.

author: Katie Barnes
title: WNBA probes 'hateful' comments toward Reese - ESPN
description: The WNBA is looking into allegations of hateful fan comments directed at Angel Reese after an incident involving Caitlin Clark and Reese in Saturday's Sky-Fever game.
content_summary: The WNBA is investigating allegations of hateful and racist fan comments directed at player Angel Reese during a highly charged game between the Chicago Sky and Indiana Fever. The incident involved a physical play between Reese and Caitlin Clark, resulting in a flagrant foul and technical fouls amidst significant fan hostility towards Reese. The league strongly condemned racism and hate, reiterating its commitment to maintaining a safe and respectful environment through initiatives like the 'No Space for Hate' platform. The WNBA Players Association supports the investigation, emphasizing zero tolerance for discriminatory behavior. Both players involved downplayed the confrontation as standard basketball conduct, but the league and teams remain focused on addressing fan misconduct and fostering inclusivity.
